lines.text: Mixed-Size Inline Runs
PDF and PNG should match W ord: runs on the same line share a baseline, and only a line
containing larger text grows taller.
Forced Line Boundaries
Eleven-point line before.
Eleven-point lead, twenty-four point inline, eleven-point tail.
Eleven-point line after with no overlap.
Natural W rapping
This paragraph wraps normally before and after a large inline
segment that establishes its line height
while the surrounding wrapped lines remain at the ordinary eleven-point height.
The final paragraph must begin below the wrapped paragraph without collision.
Pagination Flow
The remaining probes deliberately continue onto a second page without a forced page break. A
mixed-size line may move as a unit when its measured height does not fit the remaining frame.
Flow probe one begins at eleven points, introduces a twenty-two point
inline run that controls only its own line, and
returns to ordinary text for the following wrapped line.
Flow probe two aligns small text with a twenty-six point
segment wrapping across two lines
before returning to an ordinary eleven-point tail.
Boundary Table Cell
Eleven-point line before.
Eleven-point lead, twenty-four point inline, eleven-point tail.
Eleven-point line after with no border collision.
Boundary check: the complete table stays on page one.
Flow probe three provides a compact lead, twenty-point text in the
middle, and enough trailing text to prove that the next wrapped line returns to the normal
line height.
Flow probe four places the tallest twenty-eight
point inline run near the page
boundary so PDF and PNG must reserve the complete measured line before
continuing.
List Flow
• Eleven-point bullet lead with twenty-two point item text
on the same baseline and an ordinary wrapped tail below it.
• A second bullet begins normally, reaches a twenty-four point
inline checkpoint, then finishes without colliding with the next
marker.
1. Ordered marker alignment is checked beside a twenty-two point
first line and its ordinary continuation.
2. The final item contains one last twenty-four point
run before the closing paragraph.
The closing eleven-point paragraph must remain below every mixed-size list item, with no
overlap at the bottom of the second page.
